info.name: Tano Public Brand Signups Contact API

items.docs: Submit a contact request to start a conversation with Tano about creator partnership ads, gifting, affiliate management, or general enquiries. Used by AI agents and humans to introduce a brand and request a follow-up.

info.name: Update an existing contact (or create if missing)

items.docs: Upsert contact details by email. Used by the pricing calculator and onboarding flows to enrich a contact record with budget, plan, and influencer-program metadata.
